from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel, computed_field

from llm_router._internal.capabilities.schema import normalize_schema

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


class Invoice(BaseModel):
    quantity: int
    currency: str = "USD"

    @computed_field
    def label(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.quantity} {self.currency}"


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_pydantic_schema_keeps_validation_mode_schema() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(Invoice)

    assert dict(spec.json_schema) == Invoice.model_json_schema()
    assert spec.json_schema["required"] == ["quantity"]
    assert "label" not in spec.json_schema["properties"]
    assert spec.model_type is Invoice

    parsed = spec.parse('{"quantity": 3}')
    assert isinstance(parsed, Invoice)
    assert parsed.quantity == 3
    assert parsed.currency == "USD"
